posts.title: New: the Portfolio Concentration card
posts.alt_text: Animated demo of the RapidTradeView Portfolio Concentration card on a demo portfolio (40 stocks + VOO and QQQ): verdict Concentrated; "33% of your money is in 9 chip companies."; tapping Technology shows 57% of the money vs 39% in the S&P 500, including money held through VOO and QQQ; index funds are split into their sectors.

instagram.caption:
Your 40 stocks might be one bet.

RapidTradeView's new Portfolio Concentration card shows how your money is spread:
• a verdict: Spread out, Somewhat concentrated or Concentrated
• your biggest industry groups (chip companies count as one group)
• every sector next to its weight in the S&P 500
• index funds like VOO and QQQ split into their sectors

In this demo portfolio (40 stocks + VOO and QQQ) the card says: "33% of your money is in 9 chip companies." and "Technology is 57% of your money. In the S&P 500 it's 39%."

Demo portfolio, not a real one. The card shows how your money is spread; it is not advice.
